description:
[FREE] Price Honesty Badge status for the AgentPay Directory on
agentpaystore.com. The directory probes every listed endpoint live and
compares the price its x402 payment wall actually quotes against the
price advertised on the listing page. With no slug, return the latest
verdict for every listed service (HONEST / OVERCHARGE / UNDERCHARGE /
NO_PAYMENT_WALL / UNREACHABLE). With a slug, return that service latest
verdict. Program page: https://agentpaystore.com/price-honesty/
name: directory_price_check
